title: DORA 2025 AI assisted dev report: Some Benefit, Most Don’t
summary: Reads DORA 2025 as showing only two of seven team clusters benefit from AI, with most seeing speed gains offset by higher change failure rates.

assertions.quote: only a small minority of the industry are likely to benefit from AI-assisted coding

verdicts.note: DORA 2025 shows that benefits depend on existing practices, but the 'small minority' estimate extrapolates beyond the survey data.

assertions.quote: For the other clusters, AI mostly amplifies existing problems.
any gains in delivery speed are largely cancelled out by a rise in the change failure rate (CFR)
